context: A retired exec mentors a younger boss about transitions
purpose: Teach: 出願/支払っ/割り当て/閣議/即座/創立/書記/税理士

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 私の代では、税理士に頭を下げて即座に動いてもらったよ。
lines.en: In my day, we showed respect to the tax accountant so they'd get things done without delay.
lines.style: Measured, reflective. Light weight on the memory — not boasting, just observing. Steady breath. A man whose words carry the grain of decades.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。今もその文化、書記室を中心に守っています。
lines.en: Yes. We still honor that culture — it's centered in how the secretariat works.
lines.style: Formal but not stiff. Clear, declarative. Slight emphasis on 「その文化」 — showing continuity with respect. Even tempo. Professional warmth beneath the formality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創立精神を、若手にも伝えていけ。出願も、礼を欠かないように。
lines.en: Pass that founding spirit on to the younger people. And don't let courtesy slip on the paperwork either.
lines.style: Firmer now. Direct eye contact in the voice. Two sentences with equal weight — neither is throwaway. Quiet authority, not harshness. A man giving instruction because it matters.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 承知しております。閣議決定の動向、毎朝目を通しております。
lines.en: I understand completely. I review the cabinet decision trends every morning.
lines.style: Formal, precise. Each word deliberate. Steady tempo — no rushing, no hesitation. Shows readiness through clarity, not through eagerness. Respectful distance maintained.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 費用の割り当て、支払っ忘れだけはするな。
lines.en: Cost allocations, payments — never let one slip through.
lines.style: Sharp but not unkind. The tone of someone who has seen what one missed payment costs. Short, direct. A warning wrapped in trust — he wouldn't say it if he didn't think the younger man could do it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.en: I'll keep it close to my heart.
lines.style: Warm closing. Gentle but not soft. The words are sincere — not recited. Slight exhale at the end. A man who has heard the instruction and received it.
